sentences.text:
Digitally signed by VISHAL ANAND Date: 2025.12.04  O R D E R 18:30:18 IST Reason:
1. Exemption Applications are allowed.
2. The petitioner before us is a lady.

She prayed for anticipatory bail before the High Court in connection with Chapra Muffasil Police Station Case No.345/2024 for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short, IPC) respectively.

3. While disposing of the anticipatory bail application of the petitioner, the High Court thought fit to direct the parties, i.e., the petitioner  herein and the complainant to appear before the District Mediation Centre for the purpose of resolving the disputes amicably.

The High Court clarified that if the petitioner would fail to appear on 17-10-2025 before the District Court or any other date that may be fixed by the Mediator, the interim protection granted to the petitioner would automatically stand vacated.
4. The petitioner has appeared before the Mediator.
The talks for settlement are in progress.
5. We are informed that the next date of hearing before the learned Mediator is 20-12-2025.
6. Issue notice returnable on 15-1-2026.
7. The interim protection earlier granted by the High Court to continue till 15-1-2026.
8. Mr. Anshul Narayan, the learned Additional Standing counsel appearing for the State of Bihar accepts and waives formal notice for and on behalf of the State.
9. Let notice be issued to the complainant.
(VISHAL ANAND) (POOJA SHARMA)

ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
